title: POV: You Haven't Noticed Me Getting Closer To Your Plate Yet
description:
Six inches an hour. Completely undetectable. This is a stealth operation.

script: I started this operation ten minutes ago, three feet away, completely relaxed, completely uninterested. That was a lie. Every few minutes, I move slightly closer, an inch, maybe two, always while you're not looking directly at me, always with an expression that says I am simply resting here, coincidentally, near your food. At this rate I will be within striking distance shortly, and by striking distance I mean close enough to fully commit to the sad eyes. This slow creep isn't just funny, it's a genuinely calculated behavior, and dogs are shockingly good at reading exactly when to make their move. The link's below.
hookText: You haven't noticed me getting closer
